whatThisIs: Every selection control this family delivers, counted by what the packet says about it. It exists because the fleet counter that should have caught a selection control with no stated reason cannot see one on this family: the shared reader in scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/verify-packet-completeness.mjs (readFieldRows, the anchors-and-withheld shape) reads writableAnchors and withheld and does not read selectionControls at all, so requiredOptionsMissing is structurally 0 here whatever these boxes carry. That reader is shared code this lane does not own. This audit is measured in the build path and the build refuses rather than delivering a non-zero count.

requiredOptionsMissingAsTheSharedVerifie.whyItIsNotAMeasurementOfThis: the shared reader audits this family's writableAnchors and withheld rows and none of its selection controls, so this number cannot move when a selection control loses its reason
